title: ReplyEnvelope
description: A reply on the planner channel at version 4: version 3 plus one optional top-level field, provenance, saying whose words the envelope carries. Absent, the manager's, so an envelope written against 2 or 3 is a complete envelope at 4.

version.description: The reply envelope version this document was written against.

author.description: Who wrote the reply. Omitted, the planner.

provenance.description: Whose words the reply carries: manager, the manager's own ruling, which a dispatch may decline with its reason, or user, the user's words relayed, which bind. Omitted, manager. Not author, which names who sent it.

completion.description: The verdict: whether the author considers the run complete.

message.description: The verdict's message to the orchestrator.

reason.description: Why the author reached that verdict.

commands.description: The graph edits, reconciled in order.

Command.description: One graph edit, discriminated by op. Its other fields are the op's own; a settle may name the landing it was decided from.

landing.description: Where a settled node's work landed: a change request URL or a commit id.
